blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — PhilWeb Corp.’s net income rose 36 percent to P64.2 million in the third quarter of 2026 from P47 million in the previous quarter, as its digital platform business for licensed gaming operators brought in nearly two-thirds of group revenue. On Friday, the company, backed by Lance Gokongwei, said it was its third straight profitable quarter this year. READ: PhilWeb swings to P61M H1 profit The gaming technology provider earned P13.9 million in the first quarter, bringing its nine-month net income to about P125 million.
